status: preliminary; last recam_seed456/simple03 output still pending
scope: 3 simple cases; native seeds42,123,456; source video, dynamic geometry, prompt, native sampler and weights controlled within each endpoint pair
facts: Three fresh seed42 own-endpoint runs reproduce all81 historical frames pixel exactly.
The first case with ReCam endpoint extra-frontalizes in historical seed42 and both new seeds123/456; same-seed own-endpoint comparisons retain a more lateral appearance in sampled frames.
Random seed affects action details: case3 source blink at f20 appears with own-endpoint seed123 but not the historical seed42 f20 sample.
Own-endpoint case3 at seed456 also develops marked late scene/composition drift; the own endpoint is not a guarantee of stability across seeds.
interpretation: Both endpoint sensitivity and sampling instability are observed. The first-case regression cannot be attributed solely to one unlucky historical seed. Do not claim random variation is absent or that all own-endpoint runs are good.
causal_limit: Changing endpoint is a controlled input trigger, not proof of a unique internal mechanism, a corrupt ReCam image, or a geometry-only repair. Three cases and three seeds do not establish a general failure probability.
production_contract: For actual stitching always use the actual chosen Stage2 model native last frame as Stage3 native first condition plus the complete source action; never substitute a convenient Depth endpoint.
